title: real live-browser DOM evidence producer, with the three shipped-path defects it found
commit_note: The evidence content recorded here, including the IHDR-measured canonical run and the corrected claims, exists in e77d9d7 (parent 7735765). At 7735765 this file still said committed:false and had no review section.

driver.always_builds_reason: The producer used to reuse any existing build, which silently produced evidence for code no longer on disk; the run that first reported `event: projection` was reading a stale generated/runtime-lib.

canonical_run.cleanup: chrome and control pids dead; profile-matching process count 0; owned root removed

screenshot_png.dimensions_source: read from the PNG IHDR chunk by the producer and asserted, not restated from a recorded value

defects_found_and_fixed.summary: The origin emitted `event: projection` while both UI clients subscribe with addEventListener('snapshot', ...). A named SSE event with no matching listener is dropped silently, so the live view never applied a snapshot.
defects_found_and_fixed.why_unnoticed: runtime/control-process.spec.ts pinned `event: projection` on the origin side and ui/teams-console/tests/live-client.spec.ts fed a synthetic `snapshot` event on the client side, so each side's test agreed with itself and neither crossed the real origin with the real client. The D06 PART1 black box did assert the event name, but it asserted the origin's own string, so it could not detect that the client disagreed.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: The origin emits `snapshot`. The name is now pinned on both sides, in console-host/tests/http-api.spec.ts, runtime/control-process.spec.ts, and docs/evidence/acp-d06-control-20261011/black-box-control.mjs (re-run to 10/10).
defects_found_and_fixed.red_evidence: console-host/tests/http-api.spec.ts:120 expect(frames[1].startsWith('event: snapshot\n')).toBe(true) failed with '+ false' before the fix.

defects_found_and_fixed.summary: Nothing in the product called controller.startObservation(), so the shipped page never opened /api/v1/events at all.
sites: ui/teams-console/src/client/index.ts (mountTeamsConsole did not start it and its teardown did not call controller.destroy())
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: mountTeamsConsole starts observation, and its teardown calls controller.destroy() so the subscription is stopped with the mount. Both are no-ops for a fixture client.
defects_found_and_fixed.verified_by: PASS live page subscription — the shipped entry opened its own /api/v1/events (HTTP 200) and started its observation controller
defects_found_and_fixed.claim_boundary: This check proves the shipped client STARTED its subscription. It does NOT prove the shipped client applied a snapshot: ProjectionObservationController.start() emits `live` before any snapshot arrives (ui/teams-console/src/client/observation.ts:27-31), and the page also renders from its own HTTP projection fetch. Snapshot application by the shipped client is not separately observable while the projection is empty.

defects_found_and_fixed.summary: The history view had no initial read, and its only trigger is the 'previous' control, which is disabled until a page has already been read. The view could never show a record.
sites: ui/teams-console/src/client/render.ts:1053 (disabled until a page has been read)
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: selectPage('history') starts the first read, and a history page restored from persistence starts it in the constructor. Both paths are guarded on a live client, so a fixture client keeps its previous rendering instead of flipping to a HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE refusal.
defects_found_and_fixed.verified_by: PASS history readback from the page — the live history view read its own history (HTTP 200); plus unit coverage in ui/teams-console/tests/controller.spec.ts (a live client reads on open, a fixture client does not)

gaps.name: event-driven DOM markers
gaps.reason: the control daemon binds no Console/Session owner and declares no [discovery], so the projection is a real but empty snapshot; data-team-cancel, data-permission-option and data-history-record have no real source data and no event-driven animation is claimed
gaps.owner: the D06 control-owner milestone (a Console/Session owner bound into createControlOwner)

findings: F1 BLOCKING: the event-name change invalidated docs/evidence/acp-d06-control-20261011/black-box-control.mjs (it asserted `event: projection`) while the maps and governance still claimed it passed 10/10
F2 HIGH: this file and notes.md claimed the live-page-subscription check proved the shipped client applied a snapshot; it does not
F3 HIGH: the 'why unnoticed' claim that both black-box drivers read only the SSE data was false
F4 MEDIUM: the D07 gate note and two governance rows still asserted the old browser-evidence boundary
F5 LOW: ensureHistoryLoaded lacked the live-client guard its constructor path has
F6 LOW: the screenshot dimensions were restated rather than measured
F7 LOW: `committed` was false inside a commit
F8 ADVISORY: a failed-run temp root was retained and unreported
F9 ADVISORY: no unit test covered mountTeamsConsole/startObservation/ensureHistoryLoaded
review.resolution: F1-F9 all addressed on candidate e77d9d7 (parent 7735765): the D06 PART1 driver now asserts `snapshot` and was re-run to 10/10 (PART2 7/7 and the permission driver 10/10 also re-run green); the snapshot-application overclaim is corrected in the producer, notes.md and this file; the false 'why unnoticed' claim is replaced with the real reason; the D07 gate note and both governance rows now record the corrected boundary and the reduced gap count; ensureHistoryLoaded gained the live-client guard; the producer now reads and asserts the PNG dimensions from the IHDR chunk; `committed` is true; the retained temp root was removed; and controller.spec.ts gained two tests covering the history read on open for a live client and its absence for a fixture client.

scope_note: This artifact proves the live-browser DOM, the real authenticated fetch path, the shipped page's own SSE subscription, the shipped history view's own history read, and a real authenticated SSE snapshot frame in the live page context. It contains three product fixes for defects this producer found. It does not claim snapshot application by the shipped client, event-driven animation, targeted interaction, discovery rows, an installed-tarball result, or a cross-device result.
